prompt: A print-in-place articulated phone stand with three hinged joints and friction detents, so the phone angle can be set without support material.
A 3:1 planetary gearbox with herringbone gears: a sun, three planets, a ring gear and a carrier, printed as separate parts laid out on the bed.
A wall-mounted desk cable organizer with 6 snap-fit cable clips, rounded everywhere, with two countersunk screw holes.
A threaded jar and lid with an M40 thread, 2 mm pitch and 0.3 mm clearance, with a knurled grip on the lid. Print both parts.
A hex-grid honeycomb drawer insert, 120 by 80 mm and 40 mm tall, with a finger notch in each cell.
An enclosure for a Raspberry Pi 5 with ventilation slots, four M2.5 standoffs, cutouts for the USB-C, two micro HDMI, two USB 3, two USB 2 and Ethernet ports, and a snap-on lid.
A vase-style lampshade with a twisted lattice pattern and a press-fit ring for an E14 lamp socket.
A compliant-mechanism parallel gripper printed flat in one piece, with 0.8 mm thick flexures and a central push rod hole.
A 3 by 2 Gridfinity bin with a label lip, magnet holes in the base and a stacking lip.
A bicycle phone mount with a quarter-turn bayonet lock for the phone adapter and a slot for a rubber strap around the handlebar.
